SELECT mp.product_name AS itemName, mp.product_code AS itemCode, mp.product_seq AS itemSeq, CAST(mp.product_name as char character set gbk) as sortName FROM micro_product mp INNER JOIN micro_technology mt ON mp.id = mt.product_id AND mp.tenant_code = mt.tenant_code where 1=1
and( mp.product_name like concat('%', #{key}, '%') or mp.product_code like concat('%', #{key}, '%') )

SELECT product_seq as item FROM micro_product UNION SELECT product_code as item FROM micro_product

SELECT mp.id, mp.product_seq, mp.product_code, mp.product_name, mp.product_desc, mp.product_type, mp.production_mode, mp.picture, mp.unit, mp.standards, mp.remark, mu.nick_name AS created_by, mp.created_date FROM micro_product mp LEFT JOIN micro_user mu ON mp.tenant_code = mu.tenant_code AND mp.created_by = mu.id WHERE mp.created_type = '0' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT mws.product_seq FROM micro_work_submit mws WHERE mp.product_seq = mws.product_seq AND mp.tenant_code = mws.tenant_code UNION SELECT mps.product_seq FROM micro_process_storage mps WHERE mp.product_seq = mps.product_seq AND mp.tenant_code = mps.tenant_code AND mps.ng_num != 0 and mps.pass_num != 0 UNION SELECT mcr.product_seq FROM micro_complete_report mcr WHERE mcr.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code AND mcr.product_seq = mp.product_seq UNION SELECT mfps.product_seq FROM micro_finished_product_storage mfps WHERE mfps.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code AND mfps.product_seq = mp.product_seq UNION SELECT mmwo.product_seq FROM micro_manufacture_work_order mmwo WHERE mmwo.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code AND mmwo.product_seq = mp.product_seq)
